command: First retrieve config.json from Qwen/Qwen2-1.5B-Instruct at exact revision ba1cf1846d7df0a0591d6c00649f57e798519da8, record URL/revision/SHA256/license and derive hidden/intermediate/head/KV-head/head-dim/RoPE fields only from that file. Freeze a shape manifest and calculate exact 16x32 array tile counts before coding. Then parameterize the proven hidden256 schedule for target hidden size, GQA KV width, head_dim and MLP width. Add a reusable head_dim reduction and GQA multicast only if required by the pinned config. Run deterministic operation-order payload numerics through every target-shape node, stream online softmax without a score matrix, and separately report full target-shape RTL cycle counters. Segment long simulation into restartable node checkpoints without changing weights or operation order.
fixed_order: final residual and target-shape cycle report
success_condition: Pinned config provenance is exact; every target-shape intermediate node is compared to the frozen operation-order model; the physical 16x32 RTL array and FP32 SFUs produce payload evidence; no score matrix is materialized; Matrix/SFU/total cycles are measured and distinguished; CPU 8-25, max j4 and 10 GiB cap remain enforced.
failure_policy: Do not infer model dimensions from memory, switch revision, use hidden256 evidence as target-shape proof, replace payload outputs with a software bypass, report analytical tile counts as RTL-measured cycles, relax the first mismatch, materialize the score matrix, or start q128 before target-shape closure.
